name: Vacation Terminal
source:
Gavriil and Yeva, two strangers who happened to meet by chance, both travelling together, on the same train, in the same cabin, but really with not much to talk about. But when their train derails in the middle of nowhere, they're suddenly forced to work together. Gavriil wakes up alone in a cold, pitch-black cave—his leg missing, and Yeva claiming she saved his life. There’s no sign of rescue. No way to call for help 

...This was supposed to be just a short vacation.

[From [url=https://gelppy.itch.io/vacation-terminal]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加夫里尔（Gavriil）和耶娃（Yeva），两个偶然相遇的陌生人，一起旅行，在同一列火车上，在同一个车厢里，但其实没什么可说的。但当他们的火车在荒无人烟的地方脱轨时，他们突然被迫一起工作。加夫里尔在一个寒冷、漆黑的洞穴中独自醒来，他的腿不见了，耶娃声称她救了他的命。没有救援的迹象。无法寻求帮助 

……这本来只是一个短暂的假期。

[来自[url=https://gelppy.itch.io/vacation-terminal]itch.io[/url]]
